published.value: "The very fast Pont de la Concorde corner (Turn 8) is after the bridge underpass"

famousFeatures.feature: bridge underpass before Turn 8 (Pont de la Concorde corner)
famousFeatures.real: the track passes under the Avenue Pierre-Dupuy bridges and the "Pont des Iles" cycle bridge (OSM, layer 1) at s 2113.7-2135.2 m, ~60 m before the Turn 8-9 chicane
famousFeatures.game: no deck over the track: the six man_made=bridge polygons in scenery-data.js all stand beside the line (none over it); the two nearest (OSM 1266996939 / 1266996940 outlines) end ~20 m east of the centreline

famousFeatures.real: HRDEM lidar: 5.2 m range; start / pit straight ~10.6 m, a ~4.5 m rise after the Senna S (s 600-700, 3.5 % over 50 m), plateau to Turn 3, drop into Turns 3-4 (-3.6 %), 13.5-14.3 m from Turn 6 to the hairpin, then the Casino straight falls back to 10.4 m
famousFeatures.game: GLO-90 flattened to 4 m with an unrelated shape (r = 0.052): its low point (s 2060) is where the ground is level at ~14 m

banking.method: lidar heights at +-4 m across the OSM centreline every 10 m; tilt = atan((hLeft - hRight) / 8 m)

findings.game: nothing over the track at s 2113.7-2135.2 m; scenery draws bridge decks beside the line only (6 man_made=bridge polygons, none over it)
findings.real: 5 bridge ways cross over the track there (OSM 135527655, 164863796 "Pont des Iles", 413000974, 814256358, 1427698141 "Avenue Pierre-Dupuy"; all bridge=yes, layer 1): the "bridge underpass" Wikipedia names before Turn 8, the Pont de la Concorde corner
findings.proposedFix: add one deck (or the 4 parallel decks) spanning the track at s 2113.7-2135.2 m, ~21 m long along the track, clearance >= 6.5 m; build-scenery.mjs would need to turn crossing linear bridge ways (highway=* bridge=yes layer>=1) into deck polygons (buffer by their width)

findings.game: GLO-90 + FLAT_TRACKS: range 4 m, 50 m grades <= 0.9 %, correlation with the ground 0.052, rms 1.98 m (max -4.3 m at s 2030)
findings.real: NRCan HRDEM lidar along the OSM centreline: range 5.2 m (10.4-15.6 m ASL); grades flattened by > 2 pp at s 580-660 (real 3.5 %, game 0.2 %), 940-1050 (real -3.6 %, game 0 %), 1420-1530 (real 2 %, game -0.4 %). Cross-check: SRTM 30 m (OpenTopoData) correlates 0.52 with the lidar and shows the same higher middle of the lap
findings.proposedFix: new elevation source 'hrdem' (WCS GetCoverage of coverage dtm, EPSG:4326 1e-5 deg tiles, bilinear; see devtests/track-audit/americas/net.mjs hrdem()) with ELEV_SOURCE['ca-1978'] = 'hrdem' and 'ca-1978' removed from FLAT_TRACKS. Predicted in game: range 5.2 m, 3.2 % / -3.3 % over 50 m. The profile at 10 m is in profile.rows (realH) if a static override is preferred
